items.basis: the retrofit is physically installable (a swirl-vortex nozzle of some flow class exists at 14 bar), so it is not impossible; but the one claimed novel design variable is given no value or range, and the record itself lists its known failure modes as "undefined," so the artifact is under-specified rather than unbuildable. A real incompatibility also sits unaddressed: a flat-fan layout depends on fan overlap across the roll face, while swirl nozzles produce cones, so preserving coverage uniformity (the 12 micron thermal-crown requirement) is not established by "same flow class." GROUNDED_IN: REC

The prediction as stated has no truth conditions, and the verification plan does not measure the claimed effect. GROUNDED
